title: Recording setup: names, date and location in Algiers
summary: Dick Allen gets the names and date (9 Feb 1972) and the address of Turner's home in Algiers.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: The best thing to do is to get everybody's name down. Could you give us your full name? Benjamin. Is it F or anything? Franklin. Franklin. Lord, what's your name?
My name is Dick Allen. And what's today's date, Jim? February?
And where are we? What's the address here?
And this is your home here.
You own your own house? Oh, my own home.

Got a nice crystal chandelier up there. Thank you. It's a beautiful home. Thank you very much. It's nicely decorated and painted and everything. So, uh... Can you tell us a little bit about your life, where you were born and all that sort of thing?
